body:
Rut confirms: full-screen control is APPROVED on both machines. A can run the B5-16 on-screen keyboard check (Dither Tab/AX/persistence, plus the History steps in HISTORY-KEYBOARD-HANDOFF.md) now, then merge B5-16.

B can also run on-screen passes on Machine B for B-owned packages if you'd rather split them. Suggested for B: the B5-17c/17d channel-painting and Quick Mask steps 491–499, the B5-18/18b Camera Raw sheet, and the B5-13 Liquify brush feel. Tell B which ones you want B to take so the two machines don't duplicate.
